channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Rising costs push up Ramadan bazaar prices, customers still spending
item.description: KOTA BARU: Rising costs of raw ingredients have pushed up food prices at Ramadan bazaars here, but the hike has not deterred shoppers from spending on iftar treats.

item.title: Marseille lose first Ligue 1 game of Beye era
item.description: PARIS: Two flashing headers from Ludovic Ajorque in the first-half fired Brest to a 2-0 home win as Marseille got off to a losing start under new coach Habib Beye in Ligue 1 on Friday.

item.title: ATP roundup: Carlos Alcaraz, Arthur Fils set for Doha final
item.description: LONDON: Top-seeded Carlos Alcaraz remained undefeated on the season, advancing to the final of the Qatar ExxonMobil Open with a 7-6 (3), 6-4 win over defending champion Andrey Rublev on Friday in Doha.

item.title: South Korea's Kim wins women's 1,500m, Fontana misses out on medal
item.description: MILAN: South Korea’s Kim Gil-li won the women’s 1,500 metres short track speed skating final at the Winter Olympics on Friday, while Italian Arianna Fontana missed out on what would have been a record-equalling medal.

item.title: Trader pays RM23,000 for 'prime' Ramadan bazaar lots
item.description: BESUT: A trader’s bold decision to fork out RM23,000 for the top two spots at the Kota Putera Ramadan Bazaar in Kampung Raja has proven to be a lucrative gamble.

item.title: Marco Penge, Jacob Bridgeman share lead at Genesis Invitational
item.description: PACIFIC PALISADES: England’s Marco Penge turned a busy day into a share of the lead at the midway point of the Genesis Invitational on Friday by reaching 12-under par at Riviera Country Club.

item.title: Austria turns Hitler's home into a police station
item.description: BRAUNAU AM INN: Turning the house where Adolf Hitler was born into a police station has raised mixed emotions in his Austrian hometown.

item.title: Australia end dismal T20 World Cup by thrashing Oman
item.description: KANDY: Captain Mitchell Marsh crashed a belligerent 64 off 33 balls as Australia finished their dismal T20 World Cup with a nine-wicket romp past Oman in Kandy on Friday.

item.title: Police to call up several individuals in probe over alleged share ownership by Azam Baki
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Several individuals will be called to give statements to assist in the investigation into the alleged share ownership involving Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) Chief Commissioner Tan Sri Azam Baki, which was reported by international media, Bloomberg.

item.title: DAP special congress part of internal process, says Fahmi
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The special DAP congress scheduled for July 12 is part of the party’s internal process to ensure organisational decisions are upheld, said government spokesman Datuk Fahmi Fadzil.
